experiment.name: cgc-rf-tokyo-replication-v1
experiment.role: confirmatory independent-seed replication of the Tokyo 240 m high-power discrimination reversal
experiment.execution_policy: one resumable release; all five new seeds, both powers, and all primary nine-tap outcomes are reported without seed, power, estimator, support, or gate substitution

decision_rule.systematic_high_power_blind_spot: all five replicas have support; -6 dB AUC passes in at least four; +3 dB AUC fails in at least four; +3 dB direction passes in at least four; and median paired AUC(-6 minus +3) is at least 0.20
decision_rule.single_realization_exception: all five replicas have support; -6 dB and +3 dB AUC each pass in at least four; +3 dB direction passes in at least four; and +3 dB AUC fails in at most one

claim_boundary: five new independent receiver-noise and PRN-specific multipath seeds at the fixed Tokyo straight geometry, 240 m carry-off, -6/+3 dB, 25 MHz receiver RF, and the frozen nine-tap CGC estimator; no field-multipath, universal high-power, or operational claim
